audit.whatIsWrong: The page states the opposite of the truth about the single most important interaction in the matchup. spikes[1].text and mid both claim 'you have no hard CC or displacement reliably up to stop' Death Lotus. Falling Star is a stun at 1250 range and Death Lotus is a channel at 550 range — your ultimate cancels hers outright.
audit.why: Enemy R: 'Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels' with the channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'), range 550, cooldown 75/60/45. Owner R: 'This impact deals magic damage and stuns enemies', range 1250, cooldown 120/110/100. A stun landing at 1250 on a 550-range channel is the decisive interaction and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Stated across winCon, loading, breakdown.mid, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, report[5], spikes[1].text, mid and wants.you[1]: hold the 120s Falling Star specifically to cancel Death Lotus, never to clear a wave.
sources: brief enemyKit R text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] instructs the player to 'Save Voidlink (E) specifically to escape her Death Lotus channel range'. Voidlink is not an Aurelion Sol ability and does not exist in this kit. His E is the black hole (Singularity), which pulls slowly and is not an escape at all.
audit.why: Owner E per Riot: 'Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, damaging enemies and slowly pulling them toward its center'; range 750, cooldown 12, flags percentHealth/execute/zone. There is no displacement or escape on it. The only escape in the kit is Astral Flight (W).
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real answer — save Falling Star to cancel the channel. Also removed the matching false claim in spikes[1].text about 'your own E displacement'.
sources: brief ownerKit E and W text

notes: Two derived flags in this brief are tooltip-parsing misfires and I did not write anything based on them: Katarina's Bouncing Blade carries a 'grounding' flag (the Riot text only says the dagger 'ricochets onto the ground' — Bouncing Blade does not ground) and Preparation carries a 'knockup' flag (the text says she 'tosses a Dagger into the air', which is not a displacement on anyone). I also again declined the supplied missingInteraction 'Your Astral Flight (W) shuts off Katarina's Shunpo (E)' — it comes from a terrain flag on Astral Flight that contradicts Riot's description, 'Aurelion Sol flies over terrain'; he does not create terrain, so it cannot deny a blink. The genuinely load-bearing correction here is the opposite of what the page said: the page twice told the player he has nothing to stop Death Lotus, when Falling Star is a 1250-range stun and Death Lotus is a 550-range channel. Also killed 'Voidlink (E)', an ability that does not exist in Aurelion Sol's kit.
